svg.title: Ripple-carry adder: 0x7F + 0x01 and 0xFF + 0x01
svg.desc: Eight full adders in a row. The carry travels one bit at a time from bit 0 to bit 7; each full adder lights up while it adds and then shows its sum bit. Example one is 0x7F + 0x01 = 0x80 with signed overflow; example two is 0xFF + 0x01 = 0x00 with a carry out.

svg.text: The carry has to travel through every full adder, from right to left.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The carry stops inside bit 7, so the sign flips: V = 1 (signed overflow), C = 0.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The carry falls off the left end: C = 1, and the sum wraps to zero (Z = 1).

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each full_adder is 15 NANDs. A full adder cannot finish until the carry from its right neighbour arrives.
